reviews.x: Hello, This will be my third Norelco wet/dry razor and I can tell you that I have used every kind of shaving cream/lotion with it.  I agree that only using the Nivea packets can really increase the total cost of the razor so I stopped with my first Norelco wet/dry razor and I have never had a problem.  I have used Gel, foam, and even bar soap at a hotel with the razor  to no ill effects. David

reviews.t: Cost Cutting Makes This Otherwise Good Shaver Fall Short
reviews.x: For years I've had a difficult time getting a close shave and a shave with minimal irritation.  I've tried several of the Mach 3 variants with little success.  Against or with the grain the Mach 3 would miss random places on my throat (especially around the adam's apple).  I quit the Mach 3 even though the shave was otherwise close because the irriation it left made me unable to make a second pass.  My Norelco Reflex Action series left me high and dry. I tried this out after using Quadra and Reflex Norelcos for years.  I'm not impressed.  I don't get a very good shave, and my face feels irritated afterwards.  It seems to take a long time to shave compared to the dry Norelcos.  The trimmer is very inconvenient.  And the shaver tends to deposit a hair/lotion (yuck) mix on my face towards the end of my shave. reviews.t: A Very Good Electric Shaver for Sensitive Skin
reviews.x: As someone with very sensitive skin, I have always had problems with razor burn after shaving. Dry electric shavers tend to butcher my skin.  Traditional multi-blade razors (like the Mach 3) are easier on my skin, but as sensitive as my skin is, cuts are not uncommon.  A few months ago I received a Norelco 7735X Cool Skin Additive In/Out of Shower Shaver as a gift and gave it a try.  Thanks to the shaving gel that can be applied to the skin at the touch of a button while shaving, it provides a v

I'm getting older and have lost tolerance for the nicks and bleeding I get from a straight razor.  I pulled out my 30 year old Remington electric and was surprised that, with a little pre-shave lotion, it wasn't that bad. I figured razor technology had to have improved in 30 years, so I did the research and bought the Norelco 7735X.  I've had it for a week and couldn't be happier.  The "goo" that comes with it certainly helps (I prefer the gel to the lotion), but I found I get an even closer sha

And so, if you're like me, you may be looking to save a few bucks, so you're considering an electric shaver.  If that's the case, and you're willing to sacrifice having a clean-cut shave for a quick and easy shave, then this is an ideal alternative outside of the following setbacks:  1)  You will still have very very small stubs leftover, which may make you look like the Marlboro Man with his 5 'O'cloc

reviews.t: Good overall, some convenient travel features
reviews.x: I'm quite pleased with the performance of this shaver.  It's quick, comfortable and shaves closer than my previous shavers.  I use it almost exclusively "wet".  Call me a skeptic, but I've been using it with standard shaving gel for a couple of years now without issue.  I don't think there's anything particularly special about the contents of the expensive little packets, though they are very convenient for traveling, which I do frequently with this product. I love it. It gives a very close shave and is very comfortable to use. I use it in the shower every morning and it takes no time to have a great shave, no nicks, no bleeding, no irritation. However, my wife wanted to use it ... and I made her promise to let me buy a new "good shaver" if she took my 'old reliable'.  So I bought this shaver. I have always been intrigued by the idea of a wet shave, since shaving 'wet' always shaves better.  This shaver delivers on the promise and it does it extremely well. On other hand, one will face fewer cuts when compared to the old fashioned way, which is the actual reason why I kept it. In the long run, the skin gets a bit smoother also. He used it to shave his beard everyday and had a close enough shave to make both myself and his Air Force career happy. I've used this shaver for almost two years now and love it.  I'll never go back to a blade.  It takes some getting used to and practice, especially when shaving your neck, but once you get it down, it does a great job.  You also don't need to buy the Nivea replacement packs.  I use regular shaving gel and it works perfectly.  I replaced the blades after about 18 months of use and it's like have a brand new shaver.  My skin doesn't get irritated like it does with a blade, even if I have to shave

This razor is AMAZING! Using it (with the lotion) does not irritate the skin at all and clean up is ridiculously simple. My wife says that it shaves closer than my old three-blade. I think  it is as least as good and won't miss having to buy the blade refills. I will have to buy the lotion (~$1/wk), but the feeling and close shave the lotion provides is worth it.

Last one used the shaving gel, same as this one but the 7735X has a more open head design which allows for quicker and more complete cleaning. This shaver is great! I don't keep a beard, but my facial hair grows (as it tends to with most guys). I used to have an electric Braun foil shaver, but it never made the close shave like this one does. For those of you concerned about the extra cost of the gel packs, I wouldn't worry about that. The gel/shaving cream is mostly for people with very sensitive skin, and you could probably just use soap lather.  Pros:  -Very Close Shave. The best. I wouldn't trade this back for my old Braun Shaver.

reviews.t: Better than most but still not perfect
reviews.x: I ordered this for my husband who has very sensitive skin.  I thought that the lotion dispenser would be ideal for him.  I have found out that he doesn't use that feature.  When you push the button, the lotion just spits out in the one spot on the top and doesn't get distributed throughout the razor as you shave.  Otherwise, the razor seems to be serving him well but, if you are intrigued by the lotion aspect, I would reconsider.

I've used a number of other electric shavers, but this one is my favorite so far.  Using it in the shower really helps take away the irritation of shaving.  I also like the Nivea dispenser.  I agree with some of the other reviewers that the replacement cartridges are expensive, but think they are worth it.  I didn't find the dispensing button oddly placed or difficult to use. claims.text: Many reviewers say this shaver delivers a close, comfortable shave, with several calling it better than their previous blade or electric razors.
Several reviewers note that you don't need to buy the Nivea gel packs and can use regular shaving gel or lotion instead, which helps with cost.
A few reviewers report irritation, a less-close shave, or inconvenience compared to other Norelco models.
Some reviewers mention durability concerns, with one reporting the shaver stopped lasting after under a year.
Reviewers with sensitive skin report the shaver is gentle and does not cause razor burn or irritation.
